hero.subtitle: A personal travel blog sharing places I’ve been and notes from the road — places, stories, guides, and photos from journeys already behind me.

slides.imageAlt: Niagara Falls from the New York side, mist rising over the gorge
slides.caption: Niagara Falls, NY
slides.note: First look from the New York side — the roar hits before the view does. Mist on your face, a rainbow if the sun’s out, and proof that “tourist” doesn’t mean skip it.

slides.imageAlt: Sunrise over Maroon Bells reflected in a calm alpine lake
slides.caption: Maroon Bells, CO
slides.note: Sunrise at Maroon Bells — cold air, glass-still water, and twin peaks mirrored so clean it feels unreal. Worth the early alarm.

slides.imageAlt: Casa Loma Gothic castle and gardens in Toronto
slides.caption: Casa Loma, Toronto
slides.note: A Gothic castle in the middle of Toronto — turrets, gardens, and skyline peeking through. Odd, photogenic, and an easy half-day when you’re already in the city.

slides.caption: Cancún, Mexico
slides.note: Caribbean blue that doesn’t look real until you’re in it — hotel-zone mornings, Isla Mujeres day trips, and nights that run longer than planned. Five days is enough to taste it; not enough to leave ready.

author.headline: Hi, I’m Alex
author.body: I’m Alex Fernandes — traveler, photographer, and the voice behind Fernandes Journeys. Based in New Jersey, I share destinations from trips I’ve already taken: the routes, the neighborhoods, and the small details I’d tell a friend over coffee.
